'''Gray Squadron 2'''<ref name="CCG-Gray2" /> was a [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]]<ref name="S3" /> in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was part of [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], piloted by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Telsij/Legends|Telsij]]<ref name="CCG-Gray2" /> with [[Karie Neth/Legends|Karie Neth]] serving as his [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="CCG-Kian">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Karie Neth}}</ref> Gray Squadron 2 operated as [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]].<ref name="CCG-Gray2" />
